metadata.description: Shopping and gifts for Claude: search every major retailer in one place, compare prices, and send gifts. You always review and pay on Supraise.

plugins.name: supraise-shopping
plugins.description: Shop online from Claude: search and compare products and prices across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and more in one place, see photos, ratings and every seller's price, then review and pay on Supraise.

plugins.name: supraise-gift-finder
plugins.description: Find the right gift for anyone: describe the person and budget and get real products from major retailers, then send it once or set up a recurring surprise. You review and pay on Supraise.

plugins.name: supraise-gifts
plugins.description: Gift ideas for anyone from real products at Amazon, Walmart, Target and more; send one to their address or set up a gift on repeat.

plugins.name: supraise-personal-shopper
plugins.description: A personal shopper across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and more: find the right product, compare sellers and check out on Supraise.

plugins.name: supraise-send-gift
plugins.description: Send a real gift from Amazon, Walmart, Target and more to anyone's address: pick it in chat, pay on Supraise, Supraise orders it.

plugins.name: supraise-surprise-box
plugins.description: A surprise box for yourself or someone else: a gift chosen from their interests, once or every month, quarter or year.

plugins.name: supraise-price-compare
plugins.description: Compare a product's price across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and more in one search, and see which seller is cheapest.

plugins.name: supraise-shop
plugins.description: Shop Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and more in one search; buy on Supraise and send gifts once or on repeat.

plugins.name: supraise-wishlist
plugins.description: Build a wishlist of real products from Amazon, Walmart, Target and more, and share one link so friends buy the right gift without doubling up.
